interface.name: vibeshine_capture_v1

description.summary: Versioned HDR capture contract for patched Gamescope

interface.description: This additive interface leaves gamescope_pipewire v1 unchanged. Its profile event identifies the same PipeWire node and guarantees an optional xBGR_210LE capture format containing full-range BT.2020 RGB with ST 2084 transfer, rendered before the physical output's SDR tone mapping. SDR content is composited at 203 cd/m2 reference white. The capture reference volume is BT.2020/D65, 0 to 10000 cd/m2; these are rendering-space bounds, not measurements of a physical panel or source mastering metadata. MaxCLL and MaxFALL are unknown. Frame delivery follows producer GPU completion. No explicit fence or presentation timestamp is promised. The node has one negotiated format; concurrent SDR and HDR consumers require separate compositor instances. Clients must still verify the negotiated pixel format and colorimetry before advertising HDR.

event.name: hdr10_profile

description.summary: Fixed HDR10 capture profile, sent once on bind

event.description: The node must equal the gamescope_pipewire stream_node. Profile 1 denotes exactly the rendering contract described by this interface. Unknown profiles must not enable HDR.
